user.title: Battery Opt
user.description: Prices come from Home Assistant's own OMIE integration - set it up first (Settings > Devices & services > Add > OMIE). The marstek_modbus entities are optional until the battery arrives: leave all five empty for planning-only mode (plans and savings are computed, nothing actuates). Note: force_mode, rs485_control_mode, set_charge_power and charge_to_soc ship disabled by default in the Marstek integration - enable them first (user_work_mode is enabled by default). The charge-to-SoC and cutoff numbers are optional extras; the cutoff numbers do not exist on the Venus E V3, so leave them empty there. The load and grid-import sensors are also optional - everything degrades gracefully (flat load forecast, cost sensor unavailable) until they are set.
